title: Transpose of the scalar root counit
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of the l-adic rationals, a scheme T and Chern data c [def-sp-tower-class-chern], the derived scalar adjunct of lineComparison, followed by the exact restriction single comparison, is the degree-zero single map of the ordinary scalar adjunction unit on c.rootModule. The root module need not be flat.

source.place: clause (2), scalar extension and finite evaluation

proof.text: Expand lineComparison as the universal model comparison on the single root complex followed by its ordinary single comparison.
Use naturality of the exact restriction factorization and lem-sfb-scalar-model-unit to replace the derived unit and model comparison by Q of the ordinary complex unit.
The ordinary adjunction on single complexes has the ordinary unit in degree zero. Compose its two single comparisons and verify the resulting complex equality in degree zero.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarRootTranspose (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (c : Chern l E T) :
    (c.scalar.adjunction.homEquiv _ _) (lineComparison l E c) ≫
      ((SemilinearSections.res (coefficientSystemMap l E T)).mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor
        0).hom.app (lineModule l E c) =
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems T (Rrings l T)) 0).map
        (c.scalar.ordinaryAdjunction.unit.app c.rootModule)
